en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Multidisciplinary subject which comprises social, cultural, economical and environmental aspects connected with sustainable rural development and agrotourism as a part of rural tourism. Students will get information about all business connected with agrotourism which they can use for their own business, consultancy, for work in local council etc.
